description: This file defines a custom exception class 'ThingConflictException' used within the Eclipse Ditto project. It indicates a conflict when a 'Thing' with a specific ID already exists. The class includes methods for constructing instances from messages or JSON representations, as well as a builder for flexible instantiation.

classes.name: ThingConflictException
classes.description: An exception indicating that a 'Thing' with the specified ID already exists, including methods for creating and building instances, and integrating with Ditto's exception hierarchy.

classes.name: Builder
classes.description: A builder class for constructing instances of 'ThingConflictException' with a fluent API.

methods.name: fromMessage
methods.description: Creates a 'ThingConflictException' from a message string and headers.

methods.name: fromJson
methods.description: Creates a 'ThingConflictException' from a JSON object and headers.

methods.name: setDittoHeaders
methods.description: Returns a new exception instance with specified headers, preserving the existing message, description, cause, and href.
